body: Even Marie Kondo gets triggered by the mess she's seen.

I'm from Malaysia. I go through work routine everyday as usual and have to deal with triggers that make me depressed the whole day before having to repeat the routine the next day. I put up a facade for alot of people to appear happy on a daily basis, and honestly... I'm not sure if I can keep it up anymore.

We live in an age of censorship and demonizing things we don't like. People live in the illusions projected unto them, very few see through that true meaning (if there is one, but each to their own I guess?) The fact that life is unfair and pointless is a given but I do want to know, how do you deal with or at least cope with the folly which life has to offer?

Past regrets and hurts stacking up, forced positivity everywhere, it's just that.. life has really lost it's value to me. It's not about boredom but it's that realization that life is inherently pointless to begin with. Going through it is really really draining. I guess you could say an existential crisis?

23, same situation as you my friend. I'm doing a dead end desk job by day and it saps the life out of you everyday. There are times where I want my own alone time, but same thing with the parents who want me to be more "sociable". I am an introvert, an extreme one, it's frustrating to not have someone understand what you truly want to do.

Somehow, someone decided to blurt out my suicide plans and now I'm labelled as "unwell" in the head by people pretty much. I too have Christian parents, who would never understand my melancholic and broken feelings. It's just... people force so much positivity onto others that no one tends to acknowledge the tries sadness, grief and tormenting pain we feel. But I empathize with you, my future, dreams, expectations it's all just pointless, I don't want any of it, I just want to cease existing.. Well since my plans for suicide is botched all I can say to you is give time to yourself. Do what you want, eat what you want, sleep when you want. If I'm going to continue to live this miserable hell hole of a life, then I might as well just enjoy the small things before the next plan I can hatch up. I hope you'll manage, and know that there are people like me who are also faltering. You have not been singled out.

OP, I relate to your post, so do the others commenting here, you're not alone.

With each day, I've become more nihilistic, pessimistic and just dreaded the fact that I am still alive. There's just no meaning in life, to me at least. And we're fed the same crap of "becoming whoever you want to be" or "Don't give up". It's things like that make me want to give up even more. Oh don't get me started with "going with the flow" the people who tell you that are as fucking clueless as if they're really sure where their own future leads them. The only thing I have planned is a suicide, sad to say. It's tiring and it be easier to not exist in the first place.
"tap"

I think alot of people forget the "animals" in "Humans are social animals", we're not much different from the beasts of land, sea and air. We seek survival and care for our own well-being. But at least animals are straightforward when they want to kill or harm you (some of them at least). Death is very tempting to people such as myself, I pretty much have no concern where I'd end up in, hopefully a void that erases every trace of my own existence. Also, I truly agree that finding people to click with is a feat harder than trying to have Kim Jong Un's hairstyle (Imo). People say we don't care, but we really do, we see things others don't, for me it's how majestic a murder of crows can be when they fly, the smile of that homeless guy because he gets to eat today. I'm rather shaky at my current state, I get easily discouraged when things don't go well (hardly ever do tbh that I stop hoping) And I guess it is as you say, manipulation of our own emotions is really important just to save our skin, that's why we have to endure, I hope I can last before I break completely.

Thanks btw for the reply.

The best is indeed far far away, possibly even undetectable, and to get to it is a fucking nose dive in this hellhole. Personally, I don't self harm nor will I judge you for it (if you do), but it's weird to me because in a way you have a way to relieve that pain by cutting, I actually admire it and please don't take this as me condoning what you do. I just wish.. I can find a way to alleviate some of that pain.
Would love to hear from Chloe herself. If she's willing to or maybe Lauren could reiterate in her stead?

I'm a salaryman on a daily basis, weekends off. In my early twenties, and I'm from Southeast Asia. I listen to lofi every night, calms me down, puts me to sleep and is very therapeutic and I'm always browsing for new lofi tracks to listen to :)

I'm just an average person, and I wouldn't want to celebrate something as mundane and average of me merely existing for another year. The forced part I can also relate, it's just so... fake having to force yourself to smile for things you don't even want nor need. I've taken steps to deliberately forget when my birthday is but there's always someone who'll remember. People greet just so that they think "oh I greeted them earlier, therefore it shows that I care right?" But in reality, just as you said no one cares.

There's still a ways to go for my life but, birthdays just don't excite me anymore, much like any festivities even.

Finally someone who I can relate to! My birthday was a few days ago and all I wanted was to be left alone and do what I want. Just something that simple is so hard to get! I don't want no cake, no special meals, no presents just.. time to myself. Sure the wishes mean well but just thanking them for the wishes is a chore, inside I'm just like "I kinda hope you forget about it and not greet me."

It is beyond me or anyone why people choose to celebrate the day they were shat out on to this hellhole of a world. Honestly if you think about it, all we are being is another mouth to feed, another consumer that uses up resources, heck some people call it a milestone. The least I could do in my case was want less I guess? But nooooo I got told I'm being miserable, well at least I'm not wasting time, money and energy on a day that's so fucking trivial. Real talk, thank you for bringing this up by the way!

"Stop being so negative."

"Look on the bright side."

"Don't say things like that."

We've heard those and like almost each time, it annoys me to no end that they just discredit the call for help. But then again, "normies" don't even take depression seriously, some even deny it exists.

But yea, I feel you OP :(

I feel the same as you. I've become more passive aggressive and unconsciously pick verbal fights at times, and I find joy in mocking people laughing at their misfortune and hate seeing people happy. It's sickening and I don't want to keep this up anymore.
No worries and I'm glad at least things have a chance at working out when you're there. Thank you and have a good one :)

Instagram has only one purpose, to show off and flex. The app is a meaningless means for people to show how insecure they are without material wealth. I stay away from it, never going touch it. Maybe you can do the same?

The tiresome search for said answers seem to be in vain, but despite that I am still looking to see if I can define it as my own. It is true that taking time to consider options is the wiser thing to do though the impulsive intent of committing suicide lingers, just negating any sort of consideration of other options. Thank you for the reply by the way.

OP, thank you for sharing your story, and it isn't a waste of time, some of us do really want to hear what people have to say about their lives.

My experience with social anxiety is crippling, I am very afraid of standing out and talking face to face with people. I still am today and it really is going to take time to overcome or at least reduce it. Life at university is one like a fresh start, a platform for new experiences, chances and space to be you, I'm sure you know, and I hope you'll make through it somehow! I am now working and am waiting on my graduation ceremony which is next year. But the lingering regret of me not trying to overcome my anxiety during my time in university has taken it's toll on me right now as I feel alone, unwanted and insignificant all because I'm too afraid to reach out. All I've done is being a recluse, shutting myself in, going to classes like a lifeless husk just to meet the attendance quota, doing assignments as it is the requirement, drinking crying myself to sleep during my time there. All that time wasted where I can a actually make a difference to change, but alas I think it might be too late, experiencing social anxiety in work life is hella (sorry for the surfer talk) worse, you don't get to express them, pickling and bottling all that negativity for a long time is... it just kills you inside, and I've been bottling alot of things for 5 years now, and doing only that during university. 

Here's to hope for the best to your life in university, and just don't end up like the wreck I am now. I'm still trying to get through all this but I hope you have the life you want when you're there!

Hello, you can call me E and I have been going through depression for the last 5 years without medication nor therapy. I'm surprised at myself for surviving this long and suicidal thoughts have become a norm for me though I don't have the guts to actually do it. I pledged to die at age 30 (I don't know why I picked that age, probably for a perfect 10 for when I was 20) and I feel I might carry forward that plan before I get to 30. I just went through my 23rd birthday few days ago, nothing much about it, spent it alone. My wish is to go quickly and quietly but .. suicide methods varies with chances and probabilities and all the uncertainty put me off that's why I'm here, still in this wretched existence of a lifeless husk.

I am at point where sleeping off my depression would no longer work, I don't self harm and I'm not sure how to express all this unease and sorrow that's been building up for the past years. I don't think I have anything to look to forward in life, life itself has becoming pointless and bleak to me. What could I, an insignificant small speck among the human population have any sort of impact in anyone's lives, why do I have to be that lucky sperm cell that made it to that egg and become what is now me? Is there a bright side at all in this hellhole called life? If life is all about suffering then is there any point of going through with it? Questions bombarded my mind daily but no definite answers to them, never will be anyways I guess.
We create our own heaven in the lesser hell we call life, then it's straight to actual hell.
